strategy.definition: remove configured stopwords, take the first up-to-three remaining query tokens, bind each to arXiv all:, and join with AND

gap.blocking_dependency: apply reviewed delta and rerun full daily acquisition
gap.evidence_needed: CI PASS plus provider-bound daily artifact showing arXiv EXECUTED under anchor_and_v1 and preserved manifest/receipt hashes
gap.falsifier: production run BLOCKED, manifest mismatch, strategy label absent, or recall regression inconsistent with validation artifact
gap.next_probe: apply data/deltas/arxiv-production-anchor-and-v1.delta.json on the audit branch, run CI, then execute Daily Bibliography Evolution

atlas.L: exact-phrase empty -> recall probe -> anchor_and_v1 validation -> production implementation pending
atlas.O: independent query formulations plus provider-bound rerun evidence
atlas.T: arXiv retrieval -> bibliography engine -> content identities -> hypothesis ledger
atlas.C: retrieval adequacy only; not exhaustivity or scientific validation

boundary: validated retrieval strategy != implemented strategy != exhaustive literature coverage != scientific validation
